FILTERFORM.ONLOAD: select @@datdo as datdo ,(select naziv from partneri where partneriid = convert(integer,(select VarSet from PubVars where VarIme = 'NasId'))) as tkosmomi,getdate() as datdanas, (select m.naziv from partneri p inner join parstru ps on ps.partneriid=p.partneriid inner join mjesta m on m.mjestaid=ps.mjestaid where p.partneriid = convert(integer,(select VarSet from PubVars where VarIme = 'NasId')) and ps.hqind='*') AS mjesto, '@@searchboxpartneriid' as ParNaziv
FILTERFORM.CAPTION: Parametri

INPUT.NAME: partneriid
INPUT.CAPTION: Partner:*
INPUT.ONLOSTFOCUS: select naziv as nazivpartner,telefon1 as telefon,fax from vipartneri where partneriid=@@partneriid

INPUT.NAME: osobeid
INPUT.CAPTION: Potpis:*
INPUT.SQL: select distinct o.OsobeId, rtrim(coalesce(o.Ime,''))+' '+rtrim(coalesce(o.Prezime,'')) as Naziv from Osobe o inner join LnOsoPar op on o.OsobeId = op.OsobeId where op.ParStruId in (select ParStruId from ParStru where PartneriId = (select Convert(integer,VarSet) from PubVars where VarIme = 'NasId')) and op.klfunkcijeid not in (select klfunkcijeid from KlFunkcije where naziv like 'Ex Djelatnik') order by Naziv

INPUT.NAME: ok
INPUT.CAPTION: Prikaži
INPUT.ONCLICK: If @@partneriid is null begin raiserror 19001 'Obavezan unos partnera!+focus(partneriid)'end##OK
